CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)

   A. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)

13. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)

   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

15. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   D. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 7 6.2 Christian Marriage and Family 7 6.3 Alcohol, drugs and sub and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
